title: Six hub tasks are named differently from DR1 — "Main reason for importing" for "Main reason for import", "Transporter" for "Transport details", "Uploaded documents" for "Upload documents", "Contact address" for "Contact address for this consignment", "Additional commodity details" for "Additional details" and "Animal identification details" for "Identification details".

finding.frontend: The hub row titles are set in src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/hub/copy/copy.en.js:26-79. Two of them change what the task sounds like rather than just its wording: "Uploaded documents" describes a state where DR1 asks for an action, and "Transporter" names a party where DR1 names the details of the move. Each row also carries a hint sentence.
finding.prototype: DR1's row titles are "Main reason for import", "Commodity details", "Identification details", "Additional details", "Arrival details", "Transit countries", "Transport details", "Upload documents", "Roles and addresses" and "Contact address for this consignment" (app/routes.js:5749-5841). Only the roles-and-addresses row carries a hint, listing the four parties it covers.
finding.difference: Rename the six rows to DR1's wording. "Where is this consignment coming from?", "What are you importing?", "Arrival details", "Transit countries" and "Roles and addresses" already match and should be left alone. The hint sentences the frontend adds to every row are a separate change and are covered by their own finding.
finding.falsifiedBy: A frontend hub whose rows read "Main reason for import", "Transport details", "Upload documents", "Identification details" and "Contact address for this consignment".
finding.verification: Opened the fe-hub and dr1-notification-hub DOMs and both screenshots and read hub/copy/copy.en.js:26-79 and routes.js:5749-5841. Ran the falsifier by extracting every row title from each DOM and pairing them: frontend Where is this consignment coming from? / What are you importing? / Main reason for importing / Additional commodity details / Animal identification details / Arrival details / Transporter / Roles and addresses / Contact address / Uploaded documents / Check and submit, against DR1 Where is this consignment coming from? / What are you importing? / Main reason for import / Commodity details / Additional details / Arrival details / Transport details / Upload documents / Roles and addresses / Contact address for this consignment. RUBRIC 5 FIRED — the finding was understated. Five renames were listed and there is a sixth: the frontend's "Animal identification details" against DR1's "Identification details", which is in copy.en.js:47-50 and routes.js:5778-5782 and appears in neither the five nor the list of rows said to match already. It is the same change as the other five, so it is folded in here rather than raised separately. Also checked whether the row titles the finding says already match really do, since a wrong "leave it alone" is as costly as a missed rename: all five are byte-identical across the two DOMs. The "Commodity details" row DR1 has and the frontend does not is a row, not a rename, and belongs to hub--no-direct-route-to-commodity-details. The hint claim is true — DR1 renders a hint only under Roles and addresses — but I have moved it out of this finding's difference slot and into hub--task-row-hints-added.
finding.correction: CLAIMED: "Five hub tasks are named differently from DR1", with the identification row absent from both the rename list and the list of rows said to match. TRUE: six. The frontend calls the row "Animal identification details" and DR1 calls it "Identification details". CHECKED by pairing the full row-title lists read out of the two rendered DOMs, and against copy.en.js:47-50 and routes.js:5778-5782. Title, controls, difference and falsifier updated to six; the two renames the finding singles out as changing the sense of the task are unaffected. Separately, the difference slot previously ruled the frontend's hint sentences out of scope as "extra content rather than a contradiction of DR1" — that reading is not sustained; the hints are a real difference on ten rows and are now raised as hub--task-row-hints-added.

relatedTo.why: the same pass over the hub's copy
